cpr: 1. Call Emergency Services. 2. Push hard and fast in the center of the chest (100-120 bpm). 3. Perform rescue breaths if trained.
bleeding: 1. Apply direct pressure with a clean cloth. 2. Elevate the injured area. 3. Apply a pressure bandage.
burns: 1. Cool burn under cool running water for 10-20 minutes. 2. Remove tight clothing/rings. 3. Cover loosely with sterile film.
chemical: 1. Flush skin/eyes immediately with clean water for 20 minutes. 2. Remove contaminated clothing. 3. Seek emergency medical care.
